(d.status IN ('ADOPTED','DISCARDED') OR ( owner.status NOT IN ('ADOPTED','DISCARDED') AND (d.family_root_id IS NULL OR d.status!='READY' OR owner.status!='READY') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM theme_draft adopted WHERE adopted.family_root_id=owner.id AND adopted.status='ADOPTED') ))
AND d.status='DISCARDED' AND d.status!='DISCARDED'
CASE WHEN d.status='DISCARDED' THEN d.week_start ELSE coalesce(t.week_start,owner.planned_week,d.week_start) END
FROM theme_draft d JOIN theme_draft owner ON owner.id=coalesce(d.family_root_id,d.id) LEFT JOIN weekly_theme t ON t.id=d.theme_id

LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT split_part(target.value, ':', 2) AS scene FROM theme_draft child CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(child.input #> '{regenerate,targets}') target(value) LEFT JOIN theme_draft_scene_selection pick ON pick.root_id=child.family_root_id AND pick.scene=split_part(target.value, ':', 2) WHERE d.status='READY' AND child.family_root_id=owner.id AND ORDER BY array_position(ARRAY['INTRO','MON','TUE','WED','THU','FRI','OUTRO'],split_part(target.value, ':', 2)) LIMIT 1 ) pending ON true

CASE WHEN d.status='DISCARDED' THEN 'discarded' WHEN t.status='PUBLISHED' THEN 'published' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_theme p WHERE p.grade=d.grade AND p.week_start=coalesce(t.week_start,owner.planned_week) AND p.status='PUBLISHED') THEN 'closed' WHEN t.status='REVIEW_REQUIRED' THEN 'ready' WHEN d.status='ADOPTED' THEN 'adopted' WHEN d.status='GENERATING' THEN 'generating' WHEN d.status='CHECK_FAILED' THEN 'check_failed' WHEN d.status='FAILED' THEN 'failed' WHEN pending.scene IS NOT NULL THEN 'pair' ELSE 'review' END
